newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on hesitant buying amid cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on hesitant buying amid cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on hesitant buying interest amid Asian cash markets that remain at a strong discount to the U.S. market, traders said.
Traders said the benchmark Thai market was around $320.00 per tonne while the U.S. fob market was at $465.00 per tonne.
That situation was keeping rice futures rangebound despite fairly active exports of U.S. rice. Producer selling interest during mild rallies weighed on the market.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, below the 364 traded Friday.
Rice futures closed three to four cents per cwt lower, with January down three at $10.50 per cwt.
